content:
The iPhone Duo is about to launch. If you want to get your hands on accessories for Apple's new phone ahead of time, here are our top picks.

Apple Pencil: For handwritten notes, drawing, and other uses

The iPhone Duo will be the first iPhone to support Apple Pencil, letting you jot things down or sketch anywhere, whether you're on the go.

Support for Apple Pencil will be added to the iPhone Duo via a software update later. However, Apple says you'll need to use Apple Pencil (USB-C)—other Pencil models won't work.

Both the inner and outer screens of the iPhone Duo work with Apple Pencil. The design of Apple's first foldable is actually based on the proportions of a standard A-series notebook.

  • Apple Pencil (USB-C): Now $69 (was $79)

Charger: To fast-charge your iPhone Duo

The iPhone Duo supports fast charging, getting you to 50% in 20 minutes.

But to get the fastest charging speeds, you need to use a compatible charger.

Apple's 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max supports fast charging on the iPhone Duo. If you'd rather go for a third-party alternative, Anker's 100W charger is also a solid pick.

As with other models, the iPhone Duo won't come with a charger in the box—just a USB-C cable. A lot of people probably already have a 20W charger at home, but if you want the iPhone Duo to hit its top charging speed, these two products are my recommendations.

  • Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max: Now $34 (was $39)
  • Anker 100W USB-C Charger with 5-ft cable: $29

MagSafe car mount: Super handy when you're out and about

One of the iPhone accessories I've always recommended is ESR's MagSafe car mount. I've been using one myself for years and I'm confident it'll work just as well on the iPhone Duo.

With a MagSafe car mount, your iPhone has a solid home when you're out and about. The magnetic grip is strong enough to hold it securely on your AC vent, keeping it within easy reach and in your line of sight.

I like hooking my iPhone up to CarPlay while I'm driving so I can see Apple Maps navigation on the CarPlay screen, while my iPhone shows the full step-by-step directions. With the iPhone Duo's bigger screens, I'm expecting an even better experience.

  • ESR MagSafe Car Mount: Now $19 (was $29)

iPhone Duo cases

Apple hasn't started selling the $129 iPhone Duo Folio with Kickstand yet. But if you want a much more affordable iPhone Duo case, there are already plenty of third-party options out there.

Picking up an iPhone Duo case not only helps you get ready for October 23, it also lets you get a feel for the iPhone Duo's size and shape—without having to drop $1,999 or more first.

I haven't tried the cases below myself, but these are the ones I'm interested in.

  • SPIDERCASE Magnetic Case: Built-in stand and screen protector, $39
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid Pro: Clear case with MagSafe support, $34

Home cameras: To pair with the iPhone Duo's StandBy mode

The iPhone Duo will significantly upgrade the existing iPhone StandBy feature. When the iPhone Duo is in its "upright" mode, it can display various StandBy screens even without being plugged in.

StandBy options include "Home Camera" and "Home Module" screens, both of which can connect to smart home accessories.

The Home Camera screen is especially handy, giving you an at-a-glance view of all your home security cameras. Here are a few HomeKit-compatible cameras I'd recommend.

  • Aqara G100 2K Security Camera: Great value at just $39
  • eufy 4K Security Camera: If you want 4K quality, this one's not bad either at $59

Which iPhone Duo accessories are you planning to get? Let us know in the comments.

Best iPhone accessories we recommend

  • 10-year battery AirTag case
  • AirTag 2 (Now $24, was $29)
  • iPhone MagSafe car mount
  • 100W USB-C fast charger
  • HomeKit garage door opener
